xna-type.name: VertexChannelNames
xna-type.summary: Provides properties for managing a collection of vertex channel names.
xna-type.remarks: These vertex channel names can be passed to VertexChannelCollection.Add and looked up using the Name property of a specific vertex channel. The names are stored in the VertexChannel.Name property.

method.name: Binormal
method.summary: Gets the name of a binormal vector channel with the specified index.

overload.summary: Gets the name of a binormal vector channel with the specified index.

parameters.parameter: Zero-based index of the vector channel being retrieved.

overload.returns: Name of the retrieved vector channel.
